answer: Require every agent to post a refundable stake that is slashed when independent audits uncover fabricated identities or coordinated false reports. To make Sybil accounts useful, an attacker must fund each one separately and keep capital locked across the audit horizon; splitting one budget among many accounts does not multiply its voting weight. Audits can sample claims in a saffron market as the tide of activity rises, making large farms costly to sustain and exposed to measurable losses.
